_comment: Which mxm-para-07 parameters fill the collection's existing control roles.
Only roles already present in docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md are used; ids are permanent.
Envelope 1 fills Filter because it is the only envelope with that route.
Amp roles stay empty because vcaenv can select either envelope; no static mapping is correct
for every saved selector state. Both envelopes remain available to automation.
S&H timing, separate per-oscillator pitch modulation, audio-rate filter modulation,
Gate source, Trigger input, the pedal route, continuous HPF and mode-dependent modulation
Since the routing conversion the pwm_source roles are unfilled, the source switch having
become two routes, and filter_env.polarity is unfilled because the polarity is the sign of
the (Cutoff from Envelope 1) route amount -- as mxm-mono-02 and mxm-poly-06 already record.
pwm_depth, key_track and to_amp name route amounts Init wires, so no role is dead.
There is no effect mapping because this instrument contains no effect.
